Maya K: Quick pulse on serving perf sprint — kernel batching + KV warmup. Top Qs: (1) who owns kernel PR #9123 merge window? (2) is the KV prefetch rollout still blocked by infra quota? @ArunS @PriyaD please confirm. Short answers pls :thumbsup:

Arun S: I can take #9123. Targeting EOD tomorrow for merge, but need one more perf test. Running bench now, will post results by 15:00 UTC.

Priya D: KV warmup: we saw ~12% p99 token latency drop with the new prefetch heuristic on staging. Blocker = small mem leak in prefetcher patch (PR #9140). I can push patch later today, but need a quick CR from @Leo.

Leo: I'll review #9140 after stand. Quick note for canary: suggest 5% traffic with automatic fallback to existing cache if eviction rate > 8%. Also add flag `--kv-prefetch-window=128` to the rollout config.

Maya K: Sounds good. Can we make the rollout plan explicit? Steps: merge kernel PR, land KV patch, smoke canary @5%, monitor eviction and p99 for 30m, then ramp to 25% if stable. Rollback plan = toggle feature flag + route to previous model.

Arun S: Perf test output (quick):
```
latency_p50: 13ms
latency_p95: 42ms
latency_p99: 120ms
throughput: 1800 req/s
```
Looks stable but saw one tail spike at ~09:22 UTC; digging into trace.

Sam (ops-bot): Deploy scheduled: staging/runtime-kv-prefetch:v2 at 2026-03-19T15:00:00Z — CI passed. :white_check_mark:

Priya D: I'll push the mem-fix (#9140) by 16:30 UTC. Need @Leo CR + @Maya final signoff for the canary conf.

Leo: CR done, left 2 tiny comments on variable naming. Approving after those are addressed.

Maya K: Ok. Action items recap: Arun -> merge + run full perf suite; Priya -> land patch; Leo -> finish CR; Maya -> schedule canary + watch dashboards. Ping this thread when merged so I can kick the canary. Thx everyone :rocket:
